objective: Add a text render engine (engines/ascii-render, id 'ascii') so mermaid/dot snippets render as ASCII/Unicode box diagrams via 'dediren render --plugin ascii' and an MCP dediren_import text output mode.
scope_summary: New leaf engine module consuming LaidOutScene behind the existing RenderEngine seam; render-policy v3->v4 bump adding an optional text.charset block (registered family, migration entry); render-result v5->v6 widening artifact_kind to [svg,text]; MCP dediren_import gains output 'text'; docs/smoke updated. Build lanes and package model are explicitly out of scope (documented resting state, drawio precedent).
approved_decisions: New module engines/ascii-render with deps contracts, engine-api, ir only; zero new third-party dependencies; engine id 'ascii'.
Charset is policy-selectable: render-policy.schema.v4 optional text block, charset enum [unicode, ascii], default unicode box-drawing.
render-result.schema.v6 widens artifact_kind enum to [svg, text]; engine-seam bump only (no family).
Surfaces: standalone 'dediren render --plugin ascii' plus MCP dediren_import output 'text' (envelope first, diagram as second TextContent); dediren build and package model untouched.
Algorithm: anchor-preserving quantization (epsilon-merged coordinate anchors, min-gap-1 monotone mapping, content-driven widening), bitmask CharCanvas with GlyphSet UNICODE/ASCII tables.

Degrades: non-orthogonal segments L-routed with DEDIREN_ASCII_EDGE_APPROXIMATED; labels truncate with diagnostic; edge labels drop with diagnostic; UML sequence views render generically with DEDIREN_ASCII_SEQUENCE_VIEW_GENERIC.
CoreCommands.renderImportedMain gains an engine-id overload; 4-arg signature delegates with 'render'.
Implementation in worktree .worktrees/ascii-render; delegated leaves are edit-only (no Maven); parent runs every acceptance command centrally.
